note: This layer is kept strictly separate from OpenStreetMap data to avoid ODbL share-alike applying to the partner list. Each listing has water_type (tap, filtered, chilled_filtered, unknown) and chilled (true/false/null). The site loads this file independently from data/points.geojson.
